name: player_destroyed_state_reset_local_finalize
description: Player::DestroyedStateResetLocalFinalize restores local lifecycle/control/camera/damage state after a destroyed-state reset and applies the full-status pickup effect. Direct production host: mission.cpp.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the coherent Player destroyed-state/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x41bd20 validates reading g_GameStateOrMapTable->playerState, gating the local restore sequence on lifecycleState == 4, setting lifecycleState to 1, restoring g_PlayerPrevSteeringMode and g_PlayerPrevCameraState, calling ResetMouseControlStateAndRecenterCursor and ResetDamageStateAndTimedHitStatus, and always calling Pickup::ApplyEffect(0x386, 0, saveState).

The native smoke verifies the inactive-local path restores lifecycle and steering, clears mouse camera offsets and damage flags, and applies the full-status pickup refill through the existing HUD/status-meter path.
